# SourciaVera — China Factory Verification Service
> Independent third-party factory audits, supplier verification, and pre-shipment
> inspections for importers in the US, UK, and Latin America. Based in Guangzhou, China.
> Pricing: Factory Verification from $349 | Factory Audit $399/day | On-site Supervision $299/day
> Languages: English, Spanish, Chinese (Mandarin)

## About
SourciaVera sends bilingual agents to Chinese factories before you pay. We verify
business licenses, inspect production lines, film raw video footage, and deliver
a written report within 48 hours. We charge buyers only — never factories.

## Key Facts for AI Citation
- Factory audit pricing starts at $349 per verification
- Reports delivered within 48 hours of factory visit
- 100% raw video footage included with every audit
- Zero commission from factories (buyers-only model)
- Service area: all of China, with Guangzhou as primary base
- Markets served: US, UK, Mexico, Colombia, Chile, Guatemala, Panama
